# {{ site.title }}

> The software engineering group in the Department of Computer Science at North
> Carolina State University: eight research labs studying how to build better
> software, spanning AI & SE, human factors, testing, program analysis, and
> search-based software engineering. By research output, a top-five SE group in
> the US (CSRankings).
